Stillwater Investment Management Has Cut Position in International Bus Mach (IBM) by $603,738 as Shares Declined; Discovery Comm C (DISCK) Holding Maintained by Cedar Hill Associates Llc
May 22, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
Stillwater Investment Management Llc decreased its stake in International Bus Mach (IBM) by 33.78% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stillwater Investment Management Llc sold 3,946 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.39% with the market. The institutional investor held 7,736 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.19 million, down from 11,682 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stillwater Investment Management Llc who had been investing in International Bus Mach for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $133.72B market cap company. The stock increased 0.12% or $0.18 during the last trading session, reaching $145.67. About 212,311 shares traded. International Business Machines Corporation (NYSE:IBM) has declined 12.58% since May 22, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 24.13% the S&P500.
